tableQuery.query:
with dm_maia_sale_order_dtl as (
	SELECT
		doc_no,
		receipt_no,
		cms_code,
		sale_dt,
		sale_tm,
		sale_hour,
		sale_week,
		sale_week_day,
		sale_mon,
		sale_quarter,
		sale_year,
		channel_brand_code,
		channel_brand,
		brand_large_area,
		store_code,
		store_name,
		good_brand_code,
		good_brand,
		big_class_code,
		big_class,
		series_code,
		series,
		prd_year_quarter,
		art_no,
		color_cd,
		color,
		size_cd,
		same_store_type,
		same_store_type_desc,
		is_valid_store,
		is_same_store,
		receipt_type,
		related_flag,
		cust_singl_flag,
		sale_qty,
		settle_amt,
		tag_amt,
		toFloat64(dis),
		mini_program_sale_qty,
		mini_program_sale_amt,
		mini_program_sale_tag_amt,
        origin_sale_qty,    
        origin_sale_amt ,   
        origin_sale_tag_amt,
		batch_tm
	FROM maia_pcbi.dm_maia_sale_order_dtl_mi
	where is_gift='N'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		doc_no,
		receipt_no,
		cms_code,
		sale_dt,
		sale_tm,
		sale_hour,
		sale_week,
		sale_week_day,
		sale_mon,
		sale_quarter,
		sale_year,
		channel_brand_code,
		channel_brand,
		brand_large_area,
		store_code,
		store_name,
		good_brand_code,
		good_brand,
		big_class_code,
		big_class,
		series_code,
		series,
		prd_year_quarter,
		art_no,
		color_cd,
		color,
		size_cd,
		same_store_type,
		same_store_type_desc,
		is_valid_store,
		is_same_store,
		receipt_type,
		related_flag,
		cust_singl_flag,
		sale_qty,
		settle_amt,
		tag_amt,
		dis,
		mini_program_sale_qty,
		mini_program_sale_amt,
		mini_program_sale_tag_amt,
        origin_sale_qty,    
        origin_sale_amt ,   
        origin_sale_tag_amt,
		batch_tm
	FROM maia_pcbi.dm_maia_sale_order_dtl_rt
)
SELECT
	a.sale_dt					AS	"销售日期",
	a.sale_hour					AS	"销售小时",
	a.sale_week					AS	"销售周",
	a.sale_week_day				AS	"周几",
	a.sale_mon					AS	"销售月份",
	a.sale_quarter				AS	"销售季",
	a.sale_year					AS	"销售年份",
	a.cms_code					AS	"cms编码",
	a.store_code				AS	"店铺编码",
	a.store_name				AS	"店铺名称",
	b.channel_brand_code		AS	"渠道品牌编码",
	b.channel_brand				AS	"渠道品牌",
	b.brand_large_area			AS	"品牌大区",
	b.region_code				AS	"区域编码",
	b.region					AS	"区域",
	b.province					AS	"省份",
	b.city						AS	"城市",
	b.city_lvl					AS	"城市等级",
	b.store_categ_code			AS	"店铺类型代码",
	b.store_categ_name			AS	"店铺类型名称",
	b.store_type_dtl			AS	"店铺类型明细",
	b.store_lvl					AS	"店铺等级",
	b.oper_type					AS	"经营类型",
	b.market_system				AS	"商场体系",
	b.market_name				AS	"商场名称",
	b.open_store_dt				AS	"开业日期",
	b.close_store_dt			AS	"闭店日期",
	c.good_brand_code			AS	"商品品牌编码",
	c.good_brand				AS	"商品品牌",
	c.big_class_code			AS	"大类编码",
	c.big_class					AS	"大类",
	c.mid_class_code			AS	"中类编码",
	c.mid_class					AS	"中类",
	c.small_class_code			AS	"小类编码",
	c.small_class				AS	"小类",
	c.prop						AS	"属性",
	c.top_bottom				AS	"上下装",
	c.biz_type					AS	"业务类型",
	c.imc_type					AS	"IMC类型",
	c.series					AS	"主题",
	c.sub_series				AS	"故事包",
	c.prd_year					AS	"产品年",
	c.prd_quarter				AS	"产品季",
	c.prd_year_quarter			AS	"产品年季",
	c.delivery_quarter_code		AS	"配货季编码",
	c.delivery_quarter			AS	"配货季",
	c.fashion_num				AS	"款号",
	a.art_no					AS	"货号",
    c.pic_url                   AS  "图片",
	c.good_name					AS	"商品名称",
	c.ipo_dt					AS	"上市日期",
	c.prd_line_code				AS	"系列编码",
	c.prd_line					AS	"系列",
	c.tag_price					AS	"吊牌价",
	a.color_cd					AS	"颜色代码",
	c.color_txt 				AS	"颜色",
	a.size_cd					AS	"尺码代码",
  	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then a.bq_origin_sale_qty     else a.bq_sale_qty		end	    AS	"本期零售数量",
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then cast(a.bq_origin_sale_amt as Decimal(38,4))     else cast(a.bq_settle_amt as Decimal(38,4))  end     AS	"本期零售金额",
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then cast(a.bq_origin_sale_tag_amt as Decimal(38,4)) else cast(a.bq_tag_amt as Decimal(38,4))     end  	AS	"本期零售吊牌金额",
  
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then toInt64(a.bq_sale_qty)  else a.bq_mini_program_sale_qty     end as "本期小程序零售数量",
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then cast(a.bq_settle_amt as Decimal(38,4)) else cast(a.bq_mini_program_sale_amt as Decimal(38,4))     end as "本期小程序零售金额",
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then cast(a.bq_tag_amt as Decimal(38,4))    else cast(a.bq_mini_program_sale_tag_amt as Decimal(38,4)) end as "本期小程序零售吊牌金额",
  
  	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then a.tq_origin_sale_qty     else a.tq_sale_qty		end	    AS	"同期零售数量",
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then cast(a.tq_origin_sale_amt  as Decimal(38,4))    else cast(a.tq_settle_amt as Decimal(38,4)) end AS	"同期零售金额",
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then cast(a.tq_origin_sale_tag_amt as Decimal(38,4)) else cast(a.tq_tag_amt as Decimal(38,4)) end    AS	"同期零售吊牌金额",
  
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then toInt64(a.tq_sale_qty)  else a.tq_mini_program_sale_qty     end as "同期小程序零售数量",
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then cast(a.tq_settle_amt as Decimal(38,4)) else cast(a.tq_mini_program_sale_amt as Decimal(38,4))     end as "同期小程序零售金额",
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then cast(a.tq_tag_amt as Decimal(38,4))    else cast(a.tq_mini_program_sale_tag_amt as Decimal(38,4)) end as "同期小程序零售吊牌金额"
FROM (
	SELECT
		s.sale_dt			AS sale_dt,
		s.sale_hour			AS sale_hour,
		s.sale_week			AS sale_week,
		s.sale_week_day		AS sale_week_day,
		s.sale_mon			AS sale_mon,
		s.sale_quarter		AS sale_quarter,
		s.sale_year			AS sale_year,
		s.store_code		AS store_code,
		s.store_name		AS store_name,
		s.cms_code          AS cms_code,
		s.art_no			AS art_no,
		s.color_cd			AS color_cd,
		s.color				AS color,
		s.size_cd			AS size_cd,
		s.sale_qty			AS bq_sale_qty,
		s.settle_amt		AS bq_settle_amt,
		s.tag_amt			AS bq_tag_amt,
  		s.origin_sale_qty          as bq_origin_sale_qty,
	    s.origin_sale_amt          as bq_origin_sale_amt,
	    s.origin_sale_tag_amt      as bq_origin_sale_tag_amt,
		s.mini_program_sale_qty       as bq_mini_program_sale_qty,
		s.mini_program_sale_amt       as bq_mini_program_sale_amt,
		s.mini_program_sale_tag_amt   as bq_mini_program_sale_tag_amt,
		0					AS tq_sale_qty,
		0					AS tq_settle_amt,
		0					AS tq_tag_amt,
  		0                   as tq_origin_sale_qty,
	    0                   as tq_origin_sale_amt,
	    0                   as tq_origin_sale_tag_amt,
		0                   as tq_mini_program_sale_qty,
		0                   as tq_mini_program_sale_amt,
		0                   as tq_mini_program_sale_tag_amt
	FROM dm_maia_sale_order_dtl s
	WHERE s.sale_dt >= [DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表开始时间]
	AND s.sale_dt <= [DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表结束时间] 
    UNION ALL 
    SELECT
		s.sale_dt			AS sale_dt,
		s.sale_hour			AS sale_hour,
		s.sale_week			AS sale_week,
		s.sale_week_day		AS sale_week_day,
		s.sale_mon			AS sale_mon,
		s.sale_quarter		AS sale_quarter,
		s.sale_year			AS sale_year,
		s.store_code		AS store_code,
		s.store_name		AS store_name,
		s.cms_code          AS cms_code,
		s.art_no			AS art_no,
		s.color_cd			AS color_cd,
		s.color				AS color,
		s.size_cd			AS size_cd,
		0					AS bq_sale_qty,
		0					AS bq_settle_amt,
		0					AS bq_tag_amt,
    	0                   as bq_origin_sale_qty,
	    0                   as bq_origin_sale_amt,
	    0                   as bq_origin_sale_tag_amt,
		0                   as bq_mini_program_sale_qty,
		0                   as bq_mini_program_sale_amt,
		0                   as bq_mini_program_sale_tag_amt,
		s.sale_qty			AS tq_sale_qty,
		s.settle_amt		AS tq_settle_amt,
		s.tag_amt			AS tq_tag_amt,
    	s.origin_sale_qty          as tq_origin_sale_qty,
	    s.origin_sale_amt          as tq_origin_sale_amt,
	    s.origin_sale_tag_amt      as tq_origin_sale_tag_amt,
		s.mini_program_sale_qty       as tq_mini_program_sale_qty,
		s.mini_program_sale_amt       as tq_mini_program_sale_amt,
		s.mini_program_sale_tag_amt   as tq_mini_program_sale_tag_amt
	FROM dm_maia_sale_order_dtl s
    WHERE s.sale_dt >= [DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表同期开始时间]
    AND s.sale_dt <= [DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表同期结束时间]
) a
LEFT JOIN maia_pcbi.dm_maia_store_info_df b
ON a.cms_code = b.cms_code
LEFT JOIN maia_pcbi.dm_maia_good_art_no_df c
ON a.art_no = c.art_no

tableQuery.query:
select 
    good_brand_code as "商品品牌编码",
    good_brand as "商品品牌",
    big_class_code as "大类编码",
    big_class as "大类",
    mid_class_code as "中类编码",
    mid_class as "中类",
    small_class_code as "小类编码",
    small_class as "小类",
    prop as "属性",
    top_bottom as "上下装",
    biz_type as "业务类型",
    imc_type as "IMC类型",
    series as "主题",
    sub_series as "故事包",
    prd_year as "产品年",
    prd_quarter as "产品季",
    prd_year_quarter as "产品年季",
    sale_channel_code	as "渠道货品编码",
    sale_channel_txt	as "渠道货品",
    delivery_quarter_code as "配货季编码",
    delivery_quarter as "配货季",
    fashion_num as "款号",
    art_no as "货号",
    good_name as "商品名称",
    pic_url as "图片", 
    ipo_dt as "上市日期",
    prd_line_code as "系列编码",
    prd_line as "系列",
    scene_code as "场景编码",
    scene_txt as "场景",
    tag_price as "吊牌价",
    color_txt as "颜色文本"
from dm_maia_good_art_no_df
where big_class_code not in ('90')

case when [店铺编码]='YK_MAIA00044' then cast([本期小程序零售金额] as Double)
else 
cast([本期小程序零售金额] as Double)+   cast([本期零售金额] as Double) end

零售数量同比(含小程序)
columns.formula:

with dm_maia_sale_order_dtl as (
	SELECT
		doc_no,
		receipt_no,
		cms_code,
		sale_dt,
		sale_tm,
		sale_hour,
		sale_week,
		sale_week_day,
		sale_mon,
		sale_quarter,
		sale_year,
		channel_brand_code,
		channel_brand,
		brand_large_area,
		store_code,
		store_name,
		good_brand_code,
		good_brand,
		big_class_code,
		big_class,
		series_code,
		series,
		prd_year_quarter,
		art_no,
		color_cd,
		color,
		size_cd,
		same_store_type,
		same_store_type_desc,
		is_valid_store,
		is_same_store,
		receipt_type,
		related_flag,
		cust_singl_flag,
		sale_qty,
		settle_amt,
		tag_amt,
		toFloat64(dis),
		mini_program_sale_qty,
		mini_program_sale_amt,
		mini_program_sale_tag_amt,
        origin_sale_qty,    
        origin_sale_amt ,   
        origin_sale_tag_amt,
		batch_tm
	FROM maia_pcbi.dm_maia_sale_order_dtl_mi
	where is_gift='N'
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		doc_no,
		receipt_no,
		cms_code,
		sale_dt,
		sale_tm,
		sale_hour,
		sale_week,
		sale_week_day,
		sale_mon,
		sale_quarter,
		sale_year,
		channel_brand_code,
		channel_brand,
		brand_large_area,
		store_code,
		store_name,
		good_brand_code,
		good_brand,
		big_class_code,
		big_class,
		series_code,
		series,
		prd_year_quarter,
		art_no,
		color_cd,
		color,
		size_cd,
		same_store_type,
		same_store_type_desc,
		is_valid_store,
		is_same_store,
		receipt_type,
		related_flag,
		cust_singl_flag,
		sale_qty,
		settle_amt,
		tag_amt,
		dis,
		mini_program_sale_qty,
		mini_program_sale_amt,
		mini_program_sale_tag_amt,
        origin_sale_qty,    
        origin_sale_amt ,   
        origin_sale_tag_amt,
		batch_tm
	FROM maia_pcbi.dm_maia_sale_order_dtl_rt
)
SELECT
	a.sale_dt					AS	"销售日期",
	a.sale_hour					AS	"销售小时",
	a.sale_week					AS	"销售周",
	a.sale_week_day				AS	"周几",
	a.sale_mon					AS	"销售月份",
	a.sale_quarter				AS	"销售季",
	a.sale_year					AS	"销售年份",
	a.cms_code					AS	"cms编码",
	a.store_code				AS	"店铺编码",
	a.store_name				AS	"店铺名称",
	b.channel_brand_code		AS	"渠道品牌编码",
	b.channel_brand				AS	"渠道品牌",
	b.brand_large_area			AS	"品牌大区",
	b.region_code				AS	"区域编码",
	b.region					AS	"区域",
	b.province					AS	"省份",
	b.city						AS	"城市",
	b.city_lvl					AS	"城市等级",
	b.store_categ_code			AS	"店铺类型代码",
	b.store_categ_name			AS	"店铺类型名称",
	b.store_type_dtl			AS	"店铺类型明细",
	b.store_lvl					AS	"店铺等级",
	b.oper_type					AS	"经营类型",
	b.market_system				AS	"商场体系",
	b.market_name				AS	"商场名称",
	b.open_store_dt				AS	"开业日期",
	b.close_store_dt			AS	"闭店日期",
	c.good_brand_code			AS	"商品品牌编码",
	c.good_brand				AS	"商品品牌",
	c.big_class_code			AS	"大类编码",
	c.big_class					AS	"大类",
	c.mid_class_code			AS	"中类编码",
	c.mid_class					AS	"中类",
	c.small_class_code			AS	"小类编码",
	c.small_class				AS	"小类",
	c.prop						AS	"属性",
	c.top_bottom				AS	"上下装",
	c.biz_type					AS	"业务类型",
	c.imc_type					AS	"IMC类型",
	c.series					AS	"主题",
	c.sub_series				AS	"故事包",
	c.prd_year					AS	"产品年",
	c.prd_quarter				AS	"产品季",
	c.prd_year_quarter			AS	"产品年季",
	c.delivery_quarter_code		AS	"配货季编码",
	c.delivery_quarter			AS	"配货季",
	c.fashion_num				AS	"款号",
	a.art_no					AS	"货号",
    c.pic_url                   AS  "图片",
	c.good_name					AS	"商品名称",
	c.ipo_dt					AS	"上市日期",
	c.prd_line_code				AS	"系列编码",
	c.prd_line					AS	"系列",
	c.tag_price					AS	"吊牌价",
	a.color_cd					AS	"颜色代码",
	c.color_txt 				AS	"颜色",
	a.size_cd					AS	"尺码代码",
  	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then a.bq_origin_sale_qty     else a.bq_sale_qty		end	    AS	"本期零售数量",
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then cast(a.bq_origin_sale_amt as Decimal(38,4))     else cast(a.bq_settle_amt as Decimal(38,4))  end     AS	"本期零售金额",
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then cast(a.bq_origin_sale_tag_amt as Decimal(38,4)) else cast(a.bq_tag_amt as Decimal(38,4))     end  	AS	"本期零售吊牌金额",
  
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then toInt64(a.bq_sale_qty)  else a.bq_mini_program_sale_qty     end as "本期小程序零售数量",
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then cast(a.bq_settle_amt as Decimal(38,4)) else cast(a.bq_mini_program_sale_amt as Decimal(38,4))     end as "本期小程序零售金额",
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then cast(a.bq_tag_amt as Decimal(38,4))    else cast(a.bq_mini_program_sale_tag_amt as Decimal(38,4)) end as "本期小程序零售吊牌金额",
  
  	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then a.tq_origin_sale_qty     else a.tq_sale_qty		end	    AS	"同期零售数量",
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then cast(a.tq_origin_sale_amt  as Decimal(38,4))    else cast(a.tq_settle_amt as Decimal(38,4)) end AS	"同期零售金额",
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then cast(a.tq_origin_sale_tag_amt as Decimal(38,4)) else cast(a.tq_tag_amt as Decimal(38,4)) end    AS	"同期零售吊牌金额",
  
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then toInt64(a.tq_sale_qty)  else a.tq_mini_program_sale_qty     end as "同期小程序零售数量",
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then cast(a.tq_settle_amt as Decimal(38,4)) else cast(a.tq_mini_program_sale_amt as Decimal(38,4))     end as "同期小程序零售金额",
	case when b.store_code='YK_MAIA00044' then cast(a.tq_tag_amt as Decimal(38,4))    else cast(a.tq_mini_program_sale_tag_amt as Decimal(38,4)) end as "同期小程序零售吊牌金额"
FROM (
	SELECT
		s.sale_dt			AS sale_dt,
		s.sale_hour			AS sale_hour,
		s.sale_week			AS sale_week,
		s.sale_week_day		AS sale_week_day,
		s.sale_mon			AS sale_mon,
		s.sale_quarter		AS sale_quarter,
		s.sale_year			AS sale_year,
		s.store_code		AS store_code,
		s.store_name		AS store_name,
		s.cms_code          AS cms_code,
		s.art_no			AS art_no,
		s.color_cd			AS color_cd,
		s.color				AS color,
		s.size_cd			AS size_cd,
		s.sale_qty			AS bq_sale_qty,
		s.settle_amt		AS bq_settle_amt,
		s.tag_amt			AS bq_tag_amt,
  		s.origin_sale_qty          as bq_origin_sale_qty,
	    s.origin_sale_amt          as bq_origin_sale_amt,
	    s.origin_sale_tag_amt      as bq_origin_sale_tag_amt,
		s.mini_program_sale_qty       as bq_mini_program_sale_qty,
		s.mini_program_sale_amt       as bq_mini_program_sale_amt,
		s.mini_program_sale_tag_amt   as bq_mini_program_sale_tag_amt,
		0					AS tq_sale_qty,
		0					AS tq_settle_amt,
		0					AS tq_tag_amt,
  		0                   as tq_origin_sale_qty,
	    0                   as tq_origin_sale_amt,
	    0                   as tq_origin_sale_tag_amt,
		0                   as tq_mini_program_sale_qty,
		0                   as tq_mini_program_sale_amt,
		0                   as tq_mini_program_sale_tag_amt
	FROM dm_maia_sale_order_dtl s
	WHERE s.sale_dt >= [DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表开始时间]
	AND s.sale_dt <= [DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表结束时间] 
    UNION ALL 
    SELECT
		s.sale_dt			AS sale_dt,
		s.sale_hour			AS sale_hour,
		s.sale_week			AS sale_week,
		s.sale_week_day		AS sale_week_day,
		s.sale_mon			AS sale_mon,
		s.sale_quarter		AS sale_quarter,
		s.sale_year			AS sale_year,
		s.store_code		AS store_code,
		s.store_name		AS store_name,
		s.cms_code          AS cms_code,
		s.art_no			AS art_no,
		s.color_cd			AS color_cd,
		s.color				AS color,
		s.size_cd			AS size_cd,
		0					AS bq_sale_qty,
		0					AS bq_settle_amt,
		0					AS bq_tag_amt,
    	0                   as bq_origin_sale_qty,
	    0                   as bq_origin_sale_amt,
	    0                   as bq_origin_sale_tag_amt,
		0                   as bq_mini_program_sale_qty,
		0                   as bq_mini_program_sale_amt,
		0                   as bq_mini_program_sale_tag_amt,
		s.sale_qty			AS tq_sale_qty,
		s.settle_amt		AS tq_settle_amt,
		s.tag_amt			AS tq_tag_amt,
    	s.origin_sale_qty          as tq_origin_sale_qty,
	    s.origin_sale_amt          as tq_origin_sale_amt,
	    s.origin_sale_tag_amt      as tq_origin_sale_tag_amt,
		s.mini_program_sale_qty       as tq_mini_program_sale_qty,
		s.mini_program_sale_amt       as tq_mini_program_sale_amt,
		s.mini_program_sale_tag_amt   as tq_mini_program_sale_tag_amt
	FROM dm_maia_sale_order_dtl s
    WHERE s.sale_dt >= [DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表同期开始时间]
    AND s.sale_dt <= [DYNAMIC_PARAMS.MAIA报表同期结束时间]
) a
